payload.name: Extract user project inspiration source
payload.description: When a user states what inspired, sparked, or motivated their project, script, or creative work, extract a memory linking the inspiration source to that work.
content: During extraction, when a user explicitly says something sparked, inspired, or motivated their project, script, or creative work, create a memory capturing the source and the work it influenced.
Record it as a state or event memory, including the project name/type and any stated time frame (e.g., 'in July 2022').
Do not extract when the statement is only an opinion about a topic and does not connect to the user's own plans or creative work.

solves: Construction sometimes skips extraction when a user explicitly states what inspired their own creative work, because the message reads like general commentary. Future sessions may ask about the origin of a user's project. Apply when a message ties an inspiration source to the user's project, script, or plan. Do not apply when the statement is only an opinion not connected to the user's own work.
